name: XML/JSON Import Judgment Prompt
description: Add a dedicated judgment prompt for XML/JSON structured imports and cover prompt constants plus prompt-selection routing with regression tests.

userStories.title: Add structured-import judgment prompt constants
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want dedicated normal and evidence system prompt constants for XML/JSON structured imports so imported records are no longer framed as scientific articles during judgment.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/agent/judge/judgeSinglePromptSystemPromptStructuredImport.ts` with the structured-import prompt text from `IMPORT_PLAN.md`.
Add `src/agent/judge/judgeSinglePromptEvidenceSystemPromptStructuredImport.ts` with matching evidence-extraction framing for structured XML/JSON imports.
The new prompt constants keep the existing JSON response shape and escaping instructions unchanged.
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptSelection.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptConstants.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Route structured imports to the correct system prompts
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want prompt-selection logic to choose article, patient, or structured-import prompts from article metadata so each record type gets the correct judgment framing in normal and chunked modes.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract or export pure prompt-selection helpers from `src/agent/judge.ts` so routing can be tested without invoking full judgment execution.

Prompt selection uses the existing patient path for FHIR records and the new structured-import path for records with `fullTextSource === 'structured_file_import'` or compatible imported-file routing metadata.
`judgeSinglePrompt` uses the same routing split for both the normal system prompt and the chunked evidence system prompt.
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptSelection.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptConstants.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Lock prompt constant text with regression tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want exact-value tests for article, patient, and structured-import prompt constants so future edits cannot silently change judgment framing.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/agent/judge/judgePromptConstants.test.ts` with exact-value assertions for existing article and patient normal prompts.
The same test file covers existing article and patient evidence prompts plus the new structured-import normal and evidence prompts.
The tests assert the structured-import prompt text matches the wording in `IMPORT_PLAN.md`.
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptSelection.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptConstants.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Add prompt-selection matrix tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want focused selection tests for scientific articles, FHIR patients, and structured imports so prompt routing stays correct as article sources evolve.
acceptanceCriteria: Add `src/agent/judge/judgePromptSelection.test.ts` covering prompt selection for a normal scientific article, a FHIR patient record, and a structured XML/JSON import.
The test matrix covers both normal system prompt selection and evidence system prompt selection.
The structured-import assertions prove routing works from article metadata without running an end-to-end judgment request.
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptSelection.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/agent/judge/judgePromptConstants.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes
